title: land-rush landstate load benchmark summary

officialRun_500join.note: Best attempt at 500 concurrent. All 500 joined (slow ramp + retries). 322 dropped early under colyseus.js schema fan-out; 178 held the full 60s steady window.

stableRun_300bots.note: Most stable run: 300/300 joined, 0 disconnects for full 60s, ~5.7 act/s/bot sustained.

conclusions: 500 colyseus.js connections can be established (slow ramp batch=10 + retries), but a single Node client process cannot hold them: schema patches + own_batch/combat fan-out starve the event loop and ~64% drop early (colyseus onError / socket close 4002).
Stable ceiling for one colyseus.js process with full GameState sync: ~300 concurrent bots for 60s with 0 disconnects.
Server itself stayed healthy the entire time (PID 29424); RAM plateaus ~300-340MB WS; CPU overall ~2-3.4% of 16 cores at 750-1700 actions/s.
Use PROTOCOL=land frames; failed claim/fortify also emit legacy {message} on channel 'error' in addition to land acks.
